own_solution.law: Refrigerator COP: COP = eta * T_c/(T_h - T_c); P = Q_c_dot / COP
assumptions: electrical power = compressor work input only

T2CD6.regime: the rating matters only if the required compressor input exceeds 330 W; required input 60.6 W is below it

T50E9.regime: the rating matters only if the required compressor input exceeds 330 W; required input 60.6 W is below it

defect_reasons.other: With a lamp inside, the base sentence 'the refrigerator must remove heat from it at a steady rate of 200 W' no longer describes the total removal rate (255 W); the clause 'Heat leaks in through its walls at the rate given' supports reading 200 W as the wall leak only, but the wording is strained.

notes: COP_Carnot = 275/25 = 11; actual COP = 3.3; P = 200/3.3 = 60.61 W. With a 55 W lamp inside, heat to be removed = 255 W, P = 255/3.3 = 77.27 W (lamp's own electricity excluded since only compressor power is asked). Rating 330 W is a capacity limit, not a draw: K. Test/monitor duration 90 min has no path to a steady power (could also be argued C via E = P t). Earlier-test lamp and lamp above the chest freezer are disconnected (kitchen stated at 300 K). TB1B6/T9447 use 'small lamp' without number; fine as numeral-free distractors.
